svg.title: Boundary port glyph
svg.desc: Small rounded undirected boundary port glyph, supplied as a component without a label or host node. Glyph only. Place it on the appropriate boundary and supply the position-specific port label. It does not include arrows, dotted references, nested ports or proxy dots.
